_note: A tiny, obviously fake demo season, for trying the hunt out and for the tests. Its answers are 'orbit' and '1234'. The real seasons live only on the server (see orbit_hunt_tool.py).

intro.en: This is only a demo of the hunt, with two easy riddles.
intro.id: Ini hanya contoh perburuan, dengan dua teka-teki mudah.

riddle.en: What is this game called? Investigate at the Dock.
riddle.id: Apa nama permainan ini? Selidiki di Dermaga.

text.en: A sticker on the schedule board: the answer is orbit.
text.id: Stiker di papan jadwal: jawabannya orbit.

hints.en: It's the name of the game.

riddle.en: Take a scanner to the Science Lab, investigate, and give the tones you hear as digits.
riddle.id: Bawa pemindai ke Laboratorium Sains, selidiki, dan sebutkan nada yang kamu dengar sebagai angka.
